notes:
PASS on the fake backend only. The upstream environment is an Isaac Sim 5.1.0 / Isaac Lab 2.3.0 GPU simulation (README.md:3-5) and was not installed or run here. The fake is a pure-Python kinematic G1 slice: it reproduces the 29-dimensional unified action with the G1 scale 0.5 (g1go2_flat_env_cfg.py:197-198), the 98-dimensional policy and 101-dimensional critic observation layout (:15-30), the -1.0..1.0 command ranges and 10 s resampling (:218-227), the 20 s episode at a 20 ms control period (:533-535) and the 0.25 m base-fall flag (:493-497), but has no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, sensors or noise. The real environment is vectorized: its observations are (num_envs, 98) and (num_envs, 101) tensors and its reward/terminated/truncated are (num_envs,) tensors, with the shipped num_envs=512 (:520); the fake returns one G1 environment's 98 and 101 values and scalar reward and flags and does not model the Go2 half. The fake publishes an unbounded 29-element action Box because the clone's action term (cross_embodied_mdp.py:689-710) defines no clip; the external Isaac Lab action manager's own space was not inspected, so no finite action bound is claimed. Only the shared alive reward term (weight 0.15, :366) is modelled, and the base-height transition is a synthetic placeholder marked in fake.py. The sim backend (gymnasium.make of the registered task) exists but needs the upstream task, Isaac Sim 5.1.0, Isaac Lab 2.3.0, a GPU and a Linux host; it was not run and the fake was never compared with it. Warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge stores the seed and the next reset consumes it); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x4 for action_space, observation_space, reset and close (Gymnasium interface members inherited from ManagerBasedRLEnv, whose base lies outside the clone); G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because there is no finite action bound to probe; G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the integer seed/ticks inputs and the simulator action values. No extension ids, no operator-required limits and no site-limits.example.json.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Model review checked the concrete cross-embodied entry, all citations, action/observation consumers, provenance, license metadata and R0 fake-only stop scope. In driver.py and facts.md, corrected citation spans and parking/initial-pose claims, distinguished the term scaled-action buffer from the last_action observation, recorded both 0.05 velocity scales, and disclosed the unsupported implicit live route, inactive-robot parking behavior, hardware siblings and required publication decision. Updated fake.py to return raw last_action values, apply the configured velocity observation scale and zero its synthetic alive score on termination, with the corrected source-based assertions and latch-only recovery checks in test_driver.py. The observation/terminal-score regressions failed before the fix; regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json, and the final fake gate and strict collector pass with contract_checked evidence only. The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required; licence not stated (NOASSERTION)); the package may not be published or merged into a published tree before it. For the human reviewer: Retain only as the brief permits for a declared fake-only simulator contract; backends contains fake only. The implicit gymnasium.make route supplies neither the required cfg (g1go2_flat_env_cfg.py:573-578), AppLauncher lifecycle (scripts/rsl_rl/train.py:59-61), registration imports, GPU tensor batches nor vector reward/flag conversion, and no native Isaac Sim stop was established. A single upstream environment would select Go2 because the split is num_envs // 2; the fake is a deliberate one-G1 surrogate with scalar outputs and placeholder kinematics, reward integration and episode lifecycle. The finite action envelope is unknown; no action_space_ref or invented finite device bound is asserted. Go1/G1 deployment scripts and Unitree SDK submodules are excluded. The card retains NOASSERTION and publish_review required despite Apache 2.0 setup metadata and Apache/BSD source notices; the owner must resolve publication permission.
